name: Adult White Dragon
summary: A huge chromatic dragon that breathes a cone of cold, strides over ice, and takes legendary actions.

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.text: The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, {ref:glossary/difficult-terrain} composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks.

legendaryActions.intro: Immediately after another creature's turn, the dragon can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The dragon regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

items.name: Freezing Burst

save.targets: each creature in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the dragon can see within 120 feet

items.onFailure: and the target's {ref:glossary/speed} is 0 until the end of the target's next turn.
items.onFailureOrSuccess: The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

items.name: Frightful Presence
items.text: The dragon casts *{ref:spell/fear}*, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {dc:cha}). The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

items.name: Pounce
items.text: The dragon moves up to half its {ref:glossary/speed}, and it makes one Rend attack.
